propositions: The _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES table lists only us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7 but does not guard claude-opus-4-8, which is rebar's DEFAULT_MODEL and rejects temperature in bedrock calls
Both us. and global. profile prefixes reject temperature and top_p on the opus-4-8 and opus-4-7 model families, but the override table keys on full model id and misses the global. variants
Temperature parameter=1.0 (API default) succeeds on opus-4-8 while 0.0 and 0.5 fail, indicating rejection of parameter tunability rather than lack of support

The anthropic: provider path (direct Anthropic) also lacks the claude-opus-4-8 override and silently drops temperature via pydantic-ai's _drop_unsupported_sampling_settings, masking that greedy decoding is not in effect
Code-review Pass-2 verification pins temperature=0 for determinism but runs on claude-opus-4-8 unguarded, causing silent resampling and nondeterminism in production reviews
